errors.text: The hypothesis does not incorporate the requested displacement-rate, strain-rate, or thermal-expansion constraints and therefore does not define the operating regime in those terms.
The proposed oxygen-variation experiment distinguishes oxide strengthening from the nominal mechanism, but it does not isolate grain-refinement strengthening from solute strengthening.
The claimed HCP stability threshold and Ti grain-boundary segregation mechanism are unsupported for CoCrFeNiTi by the cited evidence.
